parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN carries out comprehensive turnkey renovations of apartments, houses, and commercial spaces in Bratislava, Vienna, and other cities across Slovakia and Austria.

We can deliver a property in full — from preparing the interior design project, technical documentation, and cost estimate to construction and finishing work, interior furnishing and procurement, custom furniture manufacturing, and final installation.

The work may include demolition, building partition walls, electrical and plumbing work, preparing walls and ceilings, laying tile and flooring, painting, installing lighting, and fitting plumbing fixtures, doors, and built-in and cabinet furniture.

We pay particular attention to making sure the renovation follows the approved design project precisely. This allows us to determine the placement of furniture, lighting, electrical connection points, and plumbing in advance, select materials, and reduce the number of changes made during construction itself.
Turnkey renovation with a single team
Clients can get the full range of services from DUMSKAYA DESIGN:

items: technical documentation for the construction crew;
sourcing of lighting, plumbing fixtures, and equipment;
manufacturing of custom kitchens, wardrobes, and other furniture;
design supervision of the project’s implementation.

parts.html: We can also carry out individual stages of a renovation if the design project or part of the work has already been completed by another contractor.
Types of renovation and construction work we carry out
DUMSKAYA DESIGN carries out the full range of construction, engineering, and finishing work for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces.
Depending on the property and the chosen delivery format, we can carry out either a complete turnkey renovation or individual stages of the work.
Demolition and preparatory work
Removal of partition walls, flooring, tile, ceiling structures, doors, plumbing fixtures, and other existing interior elements. Preparing the space for construction and engineering work to begin.
Partition walls and general construction work

Building new partition walls from blocks and drywall, creating niches, enclosures, and decorative structures, preparing openings, leveling surfaces, and other construction work according to the project documentation.
Electrical work

Running new electrical wiring, installing and relocating outlets and switches, installing electrical panels and connection points for household appliances, lighting, LED accent lighting, and other electrical equipment.
Plumbing work
Laying out water supply and drain lines, relocating plumbing points, installing in-wall toilet frames, bathtubs, shower systems, washbasins, faucets, kitchen plumbing fixtures, and other equipment.
Heating and building systems

Installing and relocating radiators, preparing connections for heating equipment, installing underfloor heating, and carrying out other engineering work in line with the technical capabilities of the property.
Plastering and painting
Leveling walls and ceilings, plastering, skim coating, priming, preparing surfaces for paint or decorative finishes, and painting walls and ceilings.
Drywall work
Installation of drywall ceilings, partitions, niches, enclosures, curtain cornices, concealed lighting, and other interior structures.
Tiling
Laying ceramic and porcelain tile, mosaics, and large-format materials in bathrooms, kitchens, entrance halls, and other rooms.
Flooring
Subfloor preparation and installation of parquet, engineered wood, laminate, SPC, vinyl flooring, tile, and other types of floor materials.
Installation of doors and decorative elements
Installation of interior and concealed doors, baseboards, decorative panels, moldings, and other interior elements.
Lighting
Installation of recessed and surface-mounted fixtures, pendant lighting, track systems, decorative accent lighting, and LED profiles.
Installation of plumbing fixtures and equipment
Installation of toilets, bathtubs, shower enclosures and screens, faucets, sinks, heated towel racks, mirrors, and other equipment.
Custom furniture
Design, manufacturing, delivery, and installation of kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, TV walls, wall panels, bathroom furniture, and other made-to-measure cabinet furniture.
Interior furnishing and procurement
Selection and ordering of finishing materials, plumbing fixtures, lighting, doors, furniture, and other interior elements in line with the approved design project.
Final installation and move-in preparation
Installation of furniture, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and decorative elements, completion of installation work, and getting the interior ready for use.
Renovation cost

The cost of a renovation is calculated individually and depends on the size and condition of the property, the scope of demolition and construction work, the complexity of the engineering solutions, the chosen materials, the level of furnishing, and the required timeline.

For a preliminary assessment, you can send us a floor plan of the space, a design project, or any existing technical documentation. After reviewing the initial information, we will prepare an approximate cost, and once the scope of work has been clarified, a detailed cost estimate.

For properties without a finished project, we recommend preparing a design project and technical documentation first. This makes it possible to calculate the renovation budget more accurately before construction begins and reduces the number of additional decisions that have to be made during implementation.
Full-cycle interior delivery
With full-cycle delivery, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can guide a property from interior design and technical documentation through renovation, furnishing, and furniture installation.
This format makes it possible to coordinate all the key stages within a single project and bring the interior to life as close as possible to the approved visualizations and technical solutions.
